answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to post an escrowed performance bond to trade, gaining higher limits via verified work. A newcomer starts capped, like a young vine proving its strength before climbing. A hollow identity with no history earns no trust and cannot borrow reputation from another account. Falcon sweeps compare behaviour fingerprints; when a lookalike cluster is found, every bond in it is slashed at once. Faking a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds plus seasoning work each; one honest agent pays once, so mass fakery loses money.
